<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the peaks in the aromatic region (≈110‑160 ppm) are at 139.25, 134.60, 129.00 (two equivalent carbons), and 128.30 (two equivalent carbons). These correspond to the six carbons of a benzene ring. Therefore, the molecule contains 6 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>6</final_answer>
